question: What is the term for an intense aversion or fear triggered by viewing clusters of small holes or bumps?
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Trypophobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Trypophobia** refers to an intense aversion or fear triggered by viewing clusters of small holes, bumps, or repetitive patterns. (छिद्रों या उभारों के समूह को देखने पर होने वाला डर)
 
 
• **Example:** She felt extremely uncomfortable when she saw the lotus seed pod due to her trypophobia.
 
 
• This fear is considered a psychological reaction and is not officially classified as a phobia in the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM).
